text:
Situation: Baclofen 20 mg tablets are in short supply across Corvale sites. Corvale East has 199 tablets (34.2 days), Corvale General has 198.47 tablets (24 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 54 tablets (28.1 days). The drug is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): Our current supplier, Bryant Ranch Prepack, was inspected by FDA on 2009-06-11 and classified OAI on 2009-09-09. FDA issued a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08 for the same facility. All subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026-07-16 were classified VAI.

Our position: We have limited inventory and no FDA shortage listing to trigger allocation programs. Alternative suppliers are available but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants, preventing site verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with A-S Medication Solutions, Advagen Pharma Limited, Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee LLC, Advanced Rx of Tennessee LLC, and American Health Packaging; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to request manufacturing site disclosure from each alternative supplier; requires Quality Assurance review and approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and adjust par levels across all three Corvale sites; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: Switching patients to alternative therapies or changing dosing regimens; those are clinical decisions for treating clinicians and the committee.
